name: Test (OpenUP Capability Pattern)
description: EPF/OpenUP's Test capability pattern, modelled as a Pack: the Tester role, test work products, and the tasks for identifying, implementing, and evaluating tests against requirements.

capabilities.name: Testing
capabilities.description: Verifies the solution against requirements and quality expectations, on behalf of the Tester role.

services.name: Test Case
services.contractDescription: A specific, repeatable check of solution behaviour against a requirement.

services.name: Test Evaluation Summary
services.contractDescription: A summary assessment of test results and residual risk/quality for this increment.

items.statement: Test ideas covering the requirement's normal, boundary, and failure behaviour have been identified.
Test cases have been implemented and are repeatable.

reviewGates.name: Test Results Evaluation
reviewGates.statement: Test results have been evaluated and the solution's quality/residual risk assessed.
reviewGates.prompt: Given the test results, is the solution's quality acceptable, and is residual risk understood?
